name: What design trends should I avoid when remodeling a kitchen for resale?

mainEntity.name: What design trends should I avoid when remodeling a kitchen for resale?

acceptedAnswer.text: When remodeling for resale, it's best to avoid highly niche or overly personalized design trends. Opt for timeless and broadly appealing choices. Extreme color palettes, very trendy patterns, or custom features that cater to a unique personal taste might deter potential buyers. Stick to neutral colors for walls and fixed elements, and classic styles for cabinetry and finishes that can be easily updated by new homeowners through decor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid niche, overly personalized, or extremely trendy design choices when remodeling a kitchen for resale; opt for timeless and broadly appealing styles.
